<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Kid Goku''' is the young [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku|Goku]] of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]], who fights with the [[Special:MyLanguage/Power Pole|Power Pole]] in hand. He is the champion of [[Special:MyLanguage/Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament|Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament]] and an opponent in five Classic Saga quests. The adult Goku who teaches skills is a different NPC; see [[Special:MyLanguage/Goku|Goku]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Kid Goku is the '''champion''' of Fortuneteller Baba's Tournament, the last fighter of the gauntlet: you face him after the four contenders and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Masked Warrior|Masked Warrior]]. Unlike the contenders, he doesn't get stronger from round to round. His default stats are:
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:9--> Stage</translate> !! <translate><!--T:10--> Health / melee / ki</translate> !! <translate><!--T:11--> AI tier</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:12--> Champion</translate> || 400 / 34 / 30 || <translate><!--T:13--> Elite</translate>
|}

<translate>
<!--T:14-->
Beating him wins the tournament: '''10,000 TP''' and '''+5 alignment'''. Bouts end at knockout, so nobody dies. See [[Special:MyLanguage/Tournaments|Tournaments]] for how bouts work.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:15-->

<!--T:16-->
Kid Goku is child-sized and doesn't fly.

<!--T:17-->
* '''Power Pole:''' he always holds the [[Special:MyLanguage/Power Pole|Power Pole]] in his main hand. Defeating him doesn't give it to you.
* '''Kamehameha:''' a small Kamehameha, his only ki attack.
* '''Dodging:''' every so often he steps out of the way of an attack.

<!--T:18-->
In the tournament he fights on the '''Elite''' AI tier (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|enemy AI tiers]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:19-->

<!--T:20-->
Kid Goku is an opponent in five [[Special:MyLanguage/Classic Saga|Classic Saga]] quests. In some of them he wears a different outfit.
